title: Verify: Background grid size and palette unit tests
summary: Tests for wall, wainscot, floor and window grids
description: Write tests from the R2 criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Each background grid has its declared size
Each renders with gridToRgba using only palette colours

steps.action: Create the file. For each source in BACKGROUND_SOURCES, strip the 'room/' prefix to get the id, read ROOM_ART_SIZES[id], and assert frames.length is 1, grid.length equals height and every row length equals width.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/roomBackground.test.ts
steps.expected: Size test passes for the 4 ids

steps.action: For each source call gridToRgba(frames[0], PALETTE); build the set of 'r,g,b' from data and assert each equals a PALETTE hex converted to rgb and the distinct index count is at least 3. Also assert the wall grid contains both rampIndex('plum',2) and rampIndex('plum',3), the wainscot contains a wood-ramp index, and the window contains rampIndex('moon',5) and a brass-ramp index.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/roomBackground.test.ts
